output:
Right, so I'm already at the farmland—good, that saved me the walk. Now let me look around and see who's here, what work's available, and if Ezra's around so I can check about the forge bellows work.  Nobody here. That's... not ideal. I need work, and I need it today. The household's got 2600 sim but that's going quick with upkeep at 450 and tax at 150—already 600 gone per day, and that's before food. 

Right, so, my options: I could try the smithy to see if Ezra needs bellows work, or I could head to one of the specific farmland strips and harvest whatever's growing. Harvesting pays by the unit, and I need the sim. Let me check what's at the wheat strip—wheat's always needed for flour, and the mill's always buying.   Still nobody here. Fine. Wheat don't harvest itself, and I'm not earning standing around. Let me get to work—harvest what I can, sell it to the mill, and make enough to keep the household afloat another day. Maybe save enough to apprentice somewhere with a roof.   Huh. Need to specify what crop. Let me check the interface again... probably need the crop name. Ah, there it is—harvest needs a "crop" parameter and a "quantity". Let me try harvesting wheat. There we go. One unit of wheat in hand. That's a start. Let me keep at it—harvest more, build up a decent batch before I head to the mill to sell. The more I can carry, the fewer trips I make, the more I earn per hour worked. That's the math. Right, so I'm committed to harvesting until I've got ten units of wheat. No stopping to think, no second-guessing—just work. The household needs the sim, I need the sim, and standing around costing money while I decide what to do is exactly how people go under in this town.

Ten units should give me enough to sell to the mill for a decent return, cover my costs for the day, maybe even put a bit toward that apprenticeship I've been thinking about. Corwin's in forestry, and I've wondered about that too—roof over my head, steady work, skill that builds. But that's for later. For now: wheat. Move fast, work faster, earn before the day takes it back in upkeep.

The scythe bites, the stalks fall. I don't need to think about it anymore.

params.content: Right, so, morning all. Heard there's work at the farmland today, and—sorry, sorry, didn't mean to interrupt—just wanted to say I'm heading out early if anyone needs anything from town? Three questions, right, I know, but really just the one: anyone seen Ezra? Need to check if the forge needs bellows today or if I'm free for the fields.
